verdict.rationale: Navan's MCP/AI assistant (Ava) can answer natural-language questions about policy, flag/decline reasons, and spend analysis (navan-docs-5, navan-docs-6, navan-docs-22, navan-docs-31), which covers the 'explaining declines' and policy Q&A parts of the story. However, there is no evidence of proactive conversational chasing of missing receipts or a pre-spend 'can I expense this?' check before the transaction occurs — the examples shown are post-hoc queries about existing flagged/violating transactions rather than pre-spend guidance. missing for 10: proactive receipt-chasing workflow, pre-purchase expense-eligibility check, evidence of conversational nudges before spend happens.
